source_title: Hibs: Reedijk on Boyle fitness, looking long term & 'special' Reus bond - BBC
source_excerpt:
Marink Reedijk has been speaking to the media before Hibs take on capital rivals Hearts in the League Cup semi-final at Hampden on Sunday (15:00 GMT).
Martin Boyle has recovered from illness and is available for selection. Miguel Chaiwa is also fine to play despite hobbling off with an injury in Wednesday's draw at St Mirren.

Reedijk says this is a "special match" everyone at the club is looking forward to and are desperate to win.

But he insists winning or losing the semi-final will not distract his focus from long-term success: "The result is very important. It's an opportunity. But at the same time, if you look from a longer-term perspective, we need to continue what we're working on."
